items_all.title: ChatGPT、Reddit及Roblox被納入歐盟《數位服務法》規範
items_all.summary: 歐盟執委會（European Commission，EC）週一（8/31）宣佈，將ChatGPT納入《數位服務法》（Digital Services Act，DSA）超大型線上搜尋引擎（Very Large Online Search Engine，VLOSE）名單，Reddit與Roblox則被列為超大型線上平臺（Very Large Online Platform，VLOP），即日起適用DSA最嚴格規範，須於四個月內、即2027年1月前完成合規。

items_all.title: 應對AI漏洞挑戰，FIRST國際資安應變組織擴大漏洞研討會規模
items_all.summary: 當AI打破漏洞修補節奏，過往資安團隊尚有餘裕應對的漏洞修補時程，如今正被大幅壓縮，如何在漏洞被發現或遭AI加速利用之前重新調整應對策略，已成為產業界迫切需要解決的課題，最近FIRST國際資安應變組織宣佈，將於9月23日至25日召開VulnOptiCON 2026，將原本的Vuln4Cast研討會更名並擴大舉辦，不僅將會期拉長為3日，議程主軸也從原本以漏洞預測技術為核心，擴大納入漏洞追蹤、CVE計畫前景，以及AI如何改變漏洞發現及利用等議題，以涵蓋更廣泛的漏洞生態系統主題。

items_all.title: Google AI Releases TimesFM-3: A 330M Parameter Zero-Shot Foundation Model For Multivariate Time Series Forecasting
items_all.summary: Google Research has released TimesFM-3, a 330 million parameter time series foundation model that forecasts multiple related series in a single forward pass. Unlike every TimesFM checkpoint through 2.5, it is pretrained natively for multivariate forecasting, accepting multiple targets, past covariates, and past-future covariates with no task-specific fine-tuning. It takes the top average rank among pretrained foundation models on GIFT-Eval, fev-bench, and the TIME leaderboard. The weights, however, ship under a non-commercial, non-production license. The post Google AI Releases TimesFM-3: A 330M Parameter Zero-Shot Foundation Model For Multivariate Time Series Forecasting appeared first on MarkTechPost .
items_all.summary_zh: Google Research 發布了 TimesFM-3，這是一個擁有 3.3 億參數的時間序列基礎模型，可在一次前向傳播中預測多個相關序列。與 2.5 版本之前的所有 TimesFM 版本不同，TimesFM-3 已針對多元預測進行了原生預訓練，無需針對特定任務進行微調，即可接受多個目標值、歷史協變量以及過去-未來協變量。它在 GIFT-Eval、fev-bench 和 TIME 排行榜上，在所有預訓練基礎模型中均名列前茅。然而，其權重以非商業、非生產許可發布。本文最初發表於 MarkTechPost，標題為「Google AI 發布 TimesFM-3：用於多元時間序列預測的 3.3 億參數零樣本基礎模型」。

items_all.title: Instagram admits users often can't tell AI profiles from real people
items_all.summary: Instagram is replacing its "AI creator" tag with a new "AI-generated profile" label because users can't tell AI profiles from real people. Singularity, defined by Instagram user competence. Profiles without the label get their reach and recommendations throttled. As recently as late 2024, Meta was still planning a coexistence of AI characters and humans on the platform. The article Instagram admits users often can't tell AI profiles from real people appeared first on The Decoder .
items_all.summary_zh: 由於使用者難以區分人工智慧帳號和真人帳號，Instagram 正在用新的「人工智慧產生個人資料」標籤取代原有的「AI 創作者」標籤。使用者對 AI 帳號的辨識能力決定了帳號的傳播速度。未新增此標籤的帳號將被限制曝光和推薦。就在 2024 年底，Meta 還在計畫讓 AI 角色和真人帳號在平臺上共存。這篇文章《Instagram 承認使用者經常無法區分 AI 帳號和真人帳號》最初發表於 The Decoder 網站。

items_all.title: ChatGPT now faces stricter EU oversight as a very large search engine
items_all.summary: The EU Commission is classifying ChatGPT as a very large search engine under the Digital Services Act for the first time, with at least 45 million monthly EU users. By the end of 2026, OpenAI has to deliver risk assessments, transparency reports, and an ad archive, among other things. Whether the Commission can also demand access to training data is disputed among legal experts. The article ChatGPT now faces stricter EU oversight as a very large search engine appeared first on The Decoder .
items_all.summary_zh: 歐盟委員會首次依據《數位服務法》將ChatGPT歸類為超大型搜尋引擎，其歐盟月活躍用戶至少達4,500萬。 2026年底，OpenAI必須提交風險評估報告、透明度報告和廣告存檔等資料。歐盟委員會是否也有權要求其提供培訓數據，目前法律專家對此存在爭議。本文《ChatGPT作為超大型搜尋引擎，如今面臨更嚴格的歐盟監管》最初發表於The Decoder網站。

items_all.title: OpenAI starts charging some customers only when its AI actually works
items_all.summary: OpenAI is offering some large customers outcome-based pricing, where they pay only once the AI actually finishes a task. Salesforce, Adobe, and several startups are also moving away from fixed subscription fees. The central dispute stays the same. Who gets credit for the success, the software or the customer? The article OpenAI starts charging some customers only when its AI actually works appeared first on The Decoder .
items_all.summary_zh: OpenAI 為部分大型客戶提供以結果為基礎的定價模式，即只有在人工智慧實際完成任務後才需付費。 Salesforce、Adobe 和多家新創公司也正在逐步取消固定訂閱費用。核心爭議依然存在：成功的功勞究竟歸於軟體還是客戶？本文《OpenAI 開始僅在人工智慧實際運作後才向部分客戶收費》最初發表於 The Decoder 網站。

items_all.title: Instagram cracks down on AI accounts pretending to be human
items_all.summary: Instagram is finally taking steps to address the rise of fake AI-influencer accounts that have gotten harder to spot. It's also renaming the "AI creator" label to "AI-generated profile" to make it clear when a profile features an AI-generated person that's not a real human being. items_all.title: OpenClaw 2.0 brings simplified setup, a rebuilt browser app, and multiplayer sessions
items_all.summary: The OpenClaw Foundation has released version 2.0 of its open-source AI platform, its largest release to date with over 16,000 pull requests. New features include cloud sessions on rented machines, real-time collaboration, and a browser app rebuilt from scratch. The software now automatically detects existing resources like API keys and AI subscriptions during setup. The article OpenClaw 2.0 brings simplified setup, a rebuilt browser app, and multiplayer sessions appeared first on The Decoder .
items_all.summary_zh: OpenClaw 基金會發布了其開源 AI 平臺 2.0 版本，這是迄今為止最大的版本更新，包含了超過 16,000 個 pull request。新功能包括在租用機器上進行雲端會話、即時協作以及完全重構的瀏覽器應用程式。該軟體現在可以在設定過程中自動偵測現有資源，例如 API 金鑰和 AI 訂閱。文章《OpenClaw 2.0 帶來簡化的設定、重構的瀏覽器應用程式和多人會話》最初發表於 The Decoder 網站。

items_all.title: Bank of England chief warns new AI models threaten global financial stability

items_all.title: OpenAI計畫11月終止向Cursor直接提供AI模型
items_all.summary: OpenAI週末宣佈計畫在今年11月12日終止直接向AI輔助程式開發工具Cursor提供OpenAI模型的合約，可能和SpaceX收購Cursor有關。 OpenAI計畫結束對Cursor提供AI模型的合約，他們已對Cursor說明2026年11月12日之前為過渡期。在過渡期間，該公司仍然會提供Cursor存取現今正在使用的模型，但對方也可以選擇提早結束存取。OpenAI會在雙方確認後公佈合約終止日期。

items_all.summary: 本地AI模型工具LM Studio推出的AI代理應用Bionic，新增Shell指令自動審查功能Auto Review。Bionic可使用本地或雲端的開放模型處理程式開發、文件等工作，當AI代理準備執行Shell指令時，Auto Review會先以程式分析辨識可安全執行的操作，無法完整判斷時才交由獨立的審查代理處理，減少使用者逐一確認指令的情況。

items_all.title: OpenAI and rival AI labs are buying tens of thousands of Mac minis to train computer-use agents
items_all.summary: According to The Information, OpenAI has purchased tens of thousands of Mac minis and Mac Studios to train computer agents. Anthropic also relies on Apple hardware. Demand is so high that the most powerful models have been sold out for months. Apple’s Mac revenue rose by nearly 29 percent to $10.4 billion in the June quarter. The article OpenAI and rival AI labs are buying tens of thousands of Mac minis to train computer-use agents appeared first on The Decoder .
items_all.summary_zh: 根據The Information通報，OpenAI已購買數萬臺Mac mini和Mac Studio用於訓練電腦智慧體。 Anthropic也依賴蘋果的硬體。由於需求旺盛，效能最強的機型已售罄數月。 蘋果的的Mac產品在6月季度的營收成長了近29%，達到104億美元。文章《OpenAI及其競爭對手的AI實驗室正在採購數萬臺Mac mini以訓練電腦智慧體》最初發表於The Decoder網站。

items_all.title: OpenClaw Releases OpenClaw 2.0: Guided Model Setup, 575 ms Control UI Startup, and One Trust Boundary Per Gateway
items_all.summary: The OpenClaw Foundation has released v2026.8.1, which the project calls OpenClaw 2.0: 933 contributors, 569 first-timers, and more than 16,000 pull requests, roughly half of every PR ever merged into the repo. Setup now reuses existing subscriptions, API keys and local models. The rebuilt Control UI cut test-harness startup from about 1.6 seconds to 575 ms. Shared cloud sessions add real multiplayer, though the docs are explicit that they are not a security boundary. The post OpenClaw Releases OpenClaw 2.0: Guided Model Setup, 575 ms Control UI Startup, and One Trust Boundary Per Gateway appeared first on MarkTechPost .
items_all.summary_zh: OpenClaw 基金會發布了 v2026.8.1 版本，專案稱為 OpenClaw 2.0：總共有 933 位貢獻者，其中 569 位是首次參與，並且收到了超過 16,000 個拉取請求，約佔所有合併到程式碼庫中的拉取請求總數的一半。新版本在設定過程中可以重複使用現有的訂閱、API 金鑰和本機模型。重新建構的控制介面將測試框架的啟動時間從約 1.6 秒縮短至 575 毫秒。共享雲端會話增加了真正的多人遊戲功能，但文件明確指出它們並非安全邊界。這篇文章《OpenClaw 發布 OpenClaw 2.0：引導式模型設定、575 毫秒控制介面啟動以及每個網關一個信任邊界》最初發表於 MarkTechPost。

items_all.title: AI生成詐騙內容成新威脅，數發部與Meta、Google等四大平臺聯手建立AI源頭阻詐防線
items_all.summary: 隨著生成式AI普及，詐騙集團可大量生成詐騙文案、快速建立假帳號，甚至利用AI製作更具可信度的內容，使網路平臺成為詐騙資訊擴散的重要管道。數發部今天(8/31)宣佈將深化和四大平臺業者合作，定期與平臺業者研商與情資交換機制，由政府提供最新詐騙樣態，協助平臺將其轉化為AI模型訓練資料及偵測規則，提升主動辨識能力，讓防詐機制從事後下架轉向事前預防。 「詐欺犯罪危害防制條例」在2024年三讀透過，2025年底立法院三讀透過其修正草案，四大網路廣告平臺依法須建立詐欺風險評估、防制計畫、廣告主實名制及廣告資訊揭露制度，並配合主動或依政府通知下架涉詐廣告，以提升廣告透明度並避免冒用他人身分投放廣告。

items_all.title: Introducing wrapture
items_all.summary: Introducing wrapture New from Graham Dumpleton (of wrapt , mod_wsgi, and New Relic's Python agent fame), who describes Wrapture as taking the monkeypatching ideas from wrapt and extending them to apply to testing and tracing at the same time. Wrapture ( full documentation here ) makes it easy to wrap any function or method such that all access can be traced, or can be overridden to return a different value. It acts as both an alternative to unittest.mock and a way to implement tracing against an existing project: Attaching observation to code you do not control, recording what flows through it, and doing so without disturbing the program being watched, is a problem I have never really stopped thinking about. Wrapture includes OpenTelemetry support and even has an entirely configuration-based mechanism for adding tracing to an existing Python project, which looks like this: capture = " summary " [[ observe ]] target = " domain:Calculator " name = [ " outer " , " inner " ] [[ sink ]] type = " jsonlines " path = " trace.jsonl " This is still a very young project - just a few weeks old - but it's off to a very promising start. Interestingly, this is also Graham's first attempt at large entirely agent-driven project: Every line of code and documentation in wrapture was written by an AI assistant working under my direction. I want to be upfront about that, and equally upfront about what it was not. This was not vibe coding, where a one-shot prompt produces a pile of generated code and the person driving hopes for the best because they lack the knowledge to judge what came back. V

items_all_raw.title: ChatGPT、Reddit及Roblox被納入歐盟《數位服務法》規範
items_all_raw.summary: 歐盟執委會（European Commission，EC）週一（8/31）宣佈，將ChatGPT納入《數位服務法》（Digital Services Act，DSA）超大型線上搜尋引擎（Very Large Online Search Engine，VLOSE）名單，Reddit與Roblox則被列為超大型線上平臺（Very Large Online Platform，VLOP），即日起適用DSA最嚴格規範，須於四個月內、即2027年1月前完成合規。

items_all_raw.title: 應對AI漏洞挑戰，FIRST國際資安應變組織擴大漏洞研討會規模
items_all_raw.summary: 當AI打破漏洞修補節奏，過往資安團隊尚有餘裕應對的漏洞修補時程，如今正被大幅壓縮，如何在漏洞被發現或遭AI加速利用之前重新調整應對策略，已成為產業界迫切需要解決的課題，最近FIRST國際資安應變組織宣佈，將於9月23日至25日召開VulnOptiCON 2026，將原本的Vuln4Cast研討會更名並擴大舉辦，不僅將會期拉長為3日，議程主軸也從原本以漏洞預測技術為核心，擴大納入漏洞追蹤、CVE計畫前景，以及AI如何改變漏洞發現及利用等議題，以涵蓋更廣泛的漏洞生態系統主題。

items_all_raw.title: Introducing wrapture
items_all_raw.summary: Introducing wrapture New from Graham Dumpleton (of wrapt , mod_wsgi, and New Relic's Python agent fame), who describes Wrapture as taking the monkeypatching ideas from wrapt and extending them to apply to testing and tracing at the same time. Wrapture ( full documentation here ) makes it easy to wrap any function or method such that all access can be traced, or can be overridden to return a different value. It acts as both an alternative to unittest.mock and a way to implement tracing against an existing project: Attaching observation to code you do not control, recording what flows through it, and doing so without disturbing the program being watched, is a problem I have never really stopped thinking about. Wrapture includes OpenTelemetry support and even has an entirely configuration-based mechanism for adding tracing to an existing Python project, which looks like this: capture = " summary " [[ observe ]] target = " domain:Calculator " name = [ " outer " , " inner " ] [[ sink ]] type = " jsonlines " path = " trace.jsonl " This is still a very young project - just a few weeks old - but it's off to a very promising start. Interestingly, this is also Graham's first attempt at large entirely agent-driven project: Every line of code and documentation in wrapture was written by an AI assistant working under my direction. I want to be upfront about that, and equally upfront about what it was not. This was not vibe coding, where a one-shot prompt produces a pile of generated code and the person driving hopes for the best because they lack the knowledge to judge what came back. V

items_all_raw.title: Google AI Releases TimesFM-3: A 330M Parameter Zero-Shot Foundation Model For Multivariate Time Series Forecasting
items_all_raw.summary: Google Research has released TimesFM-3, a 330 million parameter time series foundation model that forecasts multiple related series in a single forward pass. Unlike every TimesFM checkpoint through 2.5, it is pretrained natively for multivariate forecasting, accepting multiple targets, past covariates, and past-future covariates with no task-specific fine-tuning. It takes the top average rank among pretrained foundation models on GIFT-Eval, fev-bench, and the TIME leaderboard. The weights, however, ship under a non-commercial, non-production license. The post Google AI Releases TimesFM-3: A 330M Parameter Zero-Shot Foundation Model For Multivariate Time Series Forecasting appeared first on MarkTechPost .
items_all_raw.summary_zh: Google Research 發布了 TimesFM-3，這是一個擁有 3.3 億參數的時間序列基礎模型，可在一次前向傳播中預測多個相關序列。與 2.5 版本之前的所有 TimesFM 版本不同，TimesFM-3 已針對多元預測進行了原生預訓練，無需針對特定任務進行微調，即可接受多個目標值、歷史協變量以及過去-未來協變量。它在 GIFT-Eval、fev-bench 和 TIME 排行榜上，在所有預訓練基礎模型中均名列前茅。然而，其權重以非商業、非生產許可發布。本文最初發表於 MarkTechPost，標題為「Google AI 發布 TimesFM-3：用於多元時間序列預測的 3.3 億參數零樣本基礎模型」。

items_all_raw.title: Instagram admits users often can't tell AI profiles from real people
items_all_raw.summary: Instagram is replacing its "AI creator" tag with a new "AI-generated profile" label because users can't tell AI profiles from real people. Singularity, defined by Instagram user competence. Profiles without the label get their reach and recommendations throttled. As recently as late 2024, Meta was still planning a coexistence of AI characters and humans on the platform. The article Instagram admits users often can't tell AI profiles from real people appeared first on The Decoder .
items_all_raw.summary_zh: 由於使用者難以區分人工智慧帳號和真人帳號，Instagram 正在用新的「人工智慧產生個人資料」標籤取代原有的「AI 創作者」標籤。使用者對 AI 帳號的辨識能力決定了帳號的傳播速度。未新增此標籤的帳號將被限制曝光和推薦。就在 2024 年底，Meta 還在計畫讓 AI 角色和真人帳號在平臺上共存。這篇文章《Instagram 承認使用者經常無法區分 AI 帳號和真人帳號》最初發表於 The Decoder 網站。

items_all_raw.title: ChatGPT now faces stricter EU oversight as a very large search engine
items_all_raw.summary: The EU Commission is classifying ChatGPT as a very large search engine under the Digital Services Act for the first time, with at least 45 million monthly EU users. By the end of 2026, OpenAI has to deliver risk assessments, transparency reports, and an ad archive, among other things. Whether the Commission can also demand access to training data is disputed among legal experts. The article ChatGPT now faces stricter EU oversight as a very large search engine appeared first on The Decoder .
items_all_raw.summary_zh: 歐盟委員會首次依據《數位服務法》將ChatGPT歸類為超大型搜尋引擎，其歐盟月活躍用戶至少達4,500萬。 2026年底，OpenAI必須提交風險評估報告、透明度報告和廣告存檔等資料。歐盟委員會是否也有權要求其提供培訓數據，目前法律專家對此存在爭議。本文《ChatGPT作為超大型搜尋引擎，如今面臨更嚴格的歐盟監管》最初發表於The Decoder網站。

items_all_raw.title: OpenAI starts charging some customers only when its AI actually works
items_all_raw.summary: OpenAI is offering some large customers outcome-based pricing, where they pay only once the AI actually finishes a task. Salesforce, Adobe, and several startups are also moving away from fixed subscription fees. The central dispute stays the same. Who gets credit for the success, the software or the customer? The article OpenAI starts charging some customers only when its AI actually works appeared first on The Decoder .
items_all_raw.summary_zh: OpenAI 為部分大型客戶提供以結果為基礎的定價模式，即只有在人工智慧實際完成任務後才需付費。 Salesforce、Adobe 和多家新創公司也正在逐步取消固定訂閱費用。核心爭議依然存在：成功的功勞究竟歸於軟體還是客戶？本文《OpenAI 開始僅在人工智慧實際運作後才向部分客戶收費》最初發表於 The Decoder 網站。

items_all_raw.title: Instagram cracks down on AI accounts pretending to be human
items_all_raw.summary: Instagram is finally taking steps to address the rise of fake AI-influencer accounts that have gotten harder to spot. It's also renaming the "AI creator" label to "AI-generated profile" to make it clear when a profile features an AI-generated person that's not a real human being. "We've heard that people don't like seeing a profile […]
items_all_raw.summary_zh: Instagram 終於開始採取措施應對日益猖獗的虛假 AI 網紅帳號，這些帳號越來越難以辨識。 Instagram 也將“AI 建立者”標籤更名為“AI 生成的個人資料”，以便明確區分哪些個人資料中的人物是由 AI 生成的，而非真人。 “我們瞭解到使用者不喜歡看到這樣的個人資料…”

items_all_raw.title: OpenClaw 2.0 brings simplified setup, a rebuilt browser app, and multiplayer sessions
items_all_raw.summary: The OpenClaw Foundation has released version 2.0 of its open-source AI platform, its largest release to date with over 16,000 pull requests. New features include cloud sessions on rented machines, real-time collaboration, and a browser app rebuilt from scratch. The software now automatically detects existing resources like API keys and AI subscriptions during setup. The article OpenClaw 2.0 brings simplified setup, a rebuilt browser app, and multiplayer sessions appeared first on The Decoder .
items_all_raw.summary_zh: OpenClaw 基金會發布了其開源 AI 平臺 2.0 版本，這是迄今為止最大的版本更新，包含了超過 16,000 個 pull request。新功能包括在租用機器上進行雲端會話、即時協作以及完全重構的瀏覽器應用程式。該軟體現在可以在設定過程中自動偵測現有資源，例如 API 金鑰和 AI 訂閱。文章《OpenClaw 2.0 帶來簡化的設定、重構的瀏覽器應用程式和多人會話》最初發表於 The Decoder 網站。

items_all_raw.summary: OpenAI週末宣佈計畫在今年11月12日終止直接向AI輔助程式開發工具Cursor提供OpenAI模型的合約，可能和SpaceX收購Cursor有關。 OpenAI計畫結束對Cursor提供AI模型的合約，他們已對Cursor說明2026年11月12日之前為過渡期。在過渡期間，該公司仍然會提供Cursor存取現今正在使用的模型，但對方也可以選擇提早結束存取。OpenAI會在雙方確認後公佈合約終止日期。

items_all_raw.title: 本機AI工具LM Studio Bionic新增Shell指令自動審查，先程式分析再交AI代理判斷
items_all_raw.summary: 本機AI模型工具LM Studio推出的AI代理應用Bionic，新增Shell指令自動審查功能Auto Review。Bionic可使用本機或雲端的開放模型處理程式開發、文件等工作，當AI代理準備執行Shell指令時，Auto Review會先以程式分析辨識可安全執行的操作，無法完整判斷時才交由獨立的審查代理處理，減少使用者逐一確認指令的情況。

items_all_raw.title: OpenAI and rival AI labs are buying tens of thousands of Mac minis to train computer-use agents
items_all_raw.summary: According to The Information, OpenAI has purchased tens of thousands of Mac minis and Mac Studios to train computer agents. Anthropic also relies on Apple hardware. Demand is so high that the most powerful models have been sold out for months. Apple’s Mac revenue rose by nearly 29 percent to $10.4 billion in the June quarter. The article OpenAI and rival AI labs are buying tens of thousands of Mac minis to train computer-use agents appeared first on The Decoder .
items_all_raw.summary_zh: 根據The Information通報，OpenAI已購買數萬臺Mac mini和Mac Studio用於訓練電腦智慧體。 Anthropic也依賴蘋果的硬體。由於需求旺盛，效能最強的機型已售罄數月。 蘋果的的Mac產品在6月季度的營收成長了近29%，達到104億美元。文章《OpenAI及其競爭對手的AI實驗室正在採購數萬臺Mac mini以訓練電腦智慧體》最初發表於The Decoder網站。

items_all_raw.title: OpenClaw Releases OpenClaw 2.0: Guided Model Setup, 575 ms Control UI Startup, and One Trust Boundary Per Gateway
items_all_raw.summary: The OpenClaw Foundation has released v2026.8.1, which the project calls OpenClaw 2.0: 933 contributors, 569 first-timers, and more than 16,000 pull requests, roughly half of every PR ever merged into the repo. Setup now reuses existing subscriptions, API keys and local models. The rebuilt Control UI cut test-harness startup from about 1.6 seconds to 575 ms. Shared cloud sessions add real multiplayer, though the docs are explicit that they are not a security boundary. The post OpenClaw Releases OpenClaw 2.0: Guided Model Setup, 575 ms Control UI Startup, and One Trust Boundary Per Gateway appeared first on MarkTechPost .
items_all_raw.summary_zh: OpenClaw 基金會發布了 v2026.8.1 版本，專案稱為 OpenClaw 2.0：總共有 933 位貢獻者，其中 569 位是首次參與，並且收到了超過 16,000 個拉取請求，約佔所有合併到程式碼庫中的拉取請求總數的一半。新版本在設定過程中可以重複使用現有的訂閱、API 金鑰和本機模型。重新建構的控制介面將測試框架的啟動時間從約 1.6 秒縮短至 575 毫秒。共享雲端會話增加了真正的多人遊戲功能，但文件明確指出它們並非安全邊界。這篇文章《OpenClaw 發布 OpenClaw 2.0：引導式模型設定、575 毫秒控制介面啟動以及每個網關一個信任邊界》最初發表於 MarkTechPost。

items_all_raw.title: AI生成詐騙內容成新威脅，數發部與Meta、Google等四大平臺聯手建立AI源頭阻詐防線
items_all_raw.summary: 隨著生成式AI普及，詐騙集團可大量生成詐騙文案、快速建立假帳號，甚至利用AI製作更具可信度的內容，使網路平臺成為詐騙資訊擴散的重要管道。數發部今天(8/31)宣佈將深化和四大平臺業者合作，定期與平臺業者研商與情資交換機制，由政府提供最新詐騙樣態，協助平臺將其轉化為AI模型訓練資料及偵測規則，提升主動辨識能力，讓防詐機制從事後下架轉向事前預防。 「詐欺犯罪危害防制條例」在2024年三讀透過，2025年底立法院三讀透過其修正草案，四大網路廣告平臺依法須建立詐欺風險評估、防制計畫、廣告主實名制及廣告資訊揭露制度，並配合主動或依政府通知下架涉詐廣告，以提升廣告透明度並避免冒用他人身分投放廣告。
